subject: maths

items.q: If you change one side of an equation, what must you do?
items.correct: Do the same to the other side to keep it balanced.
items.misconception: Nothing — you can change one side only.
items.random_wrong: Move every term to the left.
items.why: An equation stays true only if both sides are treated identically.

items.q: How many solutions does x² = 16 have?
items.why: Both 4² and (−4)² equal 16, so there are two solutions.
